1.title: Welcome to Klaro
1.description: Klaro is a free service. Klaro helps you understand social support better.

2.title: You don't need to be an expert
2.description: There are many social benefits. Klaro helps you find the ones that fit your situation.

3.title: Answer a few short questions
3.description: With a few questions, Klaro checks your situation. That gives you an initial orientation.

4.title: Start the check now
4.description: The check only takes a few minutes. After that, Klaro helps you with the application. You can start right away and don't need an account yet.

options.COUPLE_NO_CHILDREN: We are a couple, without children in the household.
options.COUPLE_WITH_CHILDREN: We are a couple, with children in the household.

children.title: When were your children born?
children.tip: Your children's ages matter, because separate amounts apply to children. Some benefits only exist for children under 18 or under 25.

germany.title: Do you live in Germany?
germany.tip: The benefits Klaro checks only exist if you live in Germany permanently.

options.NO: No, I do not live in Germany.

work-capacity.title: Can you work at least three hours a day?
work-capacity.tip: Some people work in a sheltered workshop, for example, and still count as having reduced earning capacity. That is why we ask even if you are working.

options.FULL: Yes, at least three hours a day.
options.TEMPORARILY_REDUCED: Not at the moment, but perhaps again later.

employment.title_single: Are you working at the moment?
employment.title_couple: Are you or your partner working at the moment?

gross-income.title: How much is your gross income per month?
gross-income.tip: Gross means the amount before tax and contributions. You can find it on your payslip. If you are not working, enter 0.

net-income.tip: Add up everything that comes in each month: wages after deductions, pension, child benefit, maintenance, other benefits.
net-income.title_single: How much money do you have available per month in total?
net-income.title_couple: How much money does your household have available per month in total?

warm-rent.title: How much is your rent per month, including bills?
warm-rent.tip: That means rent plus service charges plus heating. You can find the amount in your tenancy agreement or on your bank statement.
warm-rent.hint: You can find the amount in your tenancy agreement.

assets.tip: This means everything that has been put aside: accounts, savings books, cash, securities. You are allowed to keep some of it — how much depends on your age.
assets.title_single: How much money have you saved?
assets.title_couple: How much money have you saved together?

benefits.title: Are you already receiving a social benefit?
benefits.tip: For example Grundsicherungsgeld, Grundsicherung im Alter or Wohngeld.

options.YES: Yes, I already receive a benefit.

citizenship.title: Do you hold German citizenship or that of an EU country?

options.DE_EU: Yes, German or from an EU country.

residence-status.title: Do you have secure residence status?
residence-status.tip: Secure means, for example: a settlement permit, an open-ended residence permit, or recognition as a refugee. If your asylum procedure is still running, a separate system applies — Klaro will point you to it at the end.

options.YES: Yes, I have secure residence status.
options.NO: No, or I am not sure.

partner-gross-income.title: How much is your partner's gross income per month?
partner-gross-income.tip: Again, the amount before tax and contributions. If your partner is not working, enter 0.

result.title: Your initial assessment
result.disclaimer: This is an automated initial assessment with no legal force. It does not replace advice from a Jobcenter, a Sozialamt or an independent advice service.
result.not_applicable_group_one: 1 benefit does not concern your situation
result.not_applicable_group_other: {{count}} benefits do not concern your situation

referral.title: None of the benefits checked here fit at the moment
referral.description: That does not mean there is no support for you. The Sozialamt in your district can tell you what might apply to your situation.
referral.link: Find the Sozialamt in your district

benefit.SGB_XII_OLD_AGE_REDUCED_CAPACITY: Grundsicherung in old age and on reduced earning capacity

status.LIKELY_NO: Probably does not apply to you

reason.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Some answers are still missing for this.
reason.RETIREMENT_AGE_REACHED: You have reached the statutory retirement age.
reason.RETIREMENT_AGE_NOT_REACHED: You have not yet reached the statutory retirement age.
reason.WORK_CAPACITY_NOT_FULL: You cannot work at least three hours a day.
reason.RESIDENCE_STATUS_UNCLEAR: Your residence status needs to be assessed individually.
reason.ALREADY_RECEIVING_BENEFITS: According to your answers you already receive a comparable benefit.
reason.BENEFITS_TAKE_PRECEDENCE: If you already receive a Grundsicherung, you usually cannot receive this benefit on top.
reason.INCOME_BELOW_NEEDS: Your income does not cover the estimated need.
reason.INCOME_COVERS_NEEDS: Your income covers the estimated need.
reason.INCOME_BELOW_SUBSISTENCE: Your income is not enough to live on even before rent. A Grundsicherung is the more likely fit.
reason.ASSETS_BELOW_ALLOWANCE: Your savings are below the allowance.
reason.ASSETS_SPAN_ALLOWANCE: Your savings are around the allowance. The exact amount decides.
reason.ASSETS_ABOVE_ALLOWANCE: Your savings are above the allowance.
reason.COUPLE_ASSET_ALLOWANCE_UNKNOWN: For couples the allowance applies per person. How much you may keep together has to be checked by the responsible office.
reason.RENT_BURDEN_HIGH: Your rent is high relative to your income.
reason.RENT_BURDEN_NORMAL: Your rent is unremarkable relative to your income.
reason.NO_ELIGIBLE_CHILDREN: There are no children in your household this benefit applies to.
reason.KIZ_MIN_INCOME_MET: Your gross income reaches the minimum threshold.
reason.KIZ_MIN_INCOME_NOT_MET: Your gross income does not reach the minimum threshold. Grundsicherungsgeld for the children is the more likely fit.

hint.ASYLUM_BENEFITS_REFERRAL: If your residence is not yet secure, Asylbewerberleistungen may apply to you rather than the benefits checked here. An advice service can tell you what applies.
